scope: Actual opening of encoded picture contact sheets and full-resolution extracted PNG; not realtime playback or listening
findings: All regular captions, including former upper-left and upper-center lines, use the common lower-center style. The two-line 10.5-second caption is readable and not clipped.
Projector, monitor comparison, checked state, foreground pen/paper and physical desk sign retain their scene placements. Their content is not moved to the subtitle region.
The gratitude cue is at 3.25–4.75 seconds; impact source .75–2.25 and seat/reaction boundaries remain the V15 values.
The static full-frame event ending begins at 44 seconds and remains present through the final frame.
unchanged_limitations: Review covers sampled final encoded frames, not realtime continuous playback or actual audio listening.
